candidate.patch:9-24 appends the hive-metrics call at the very end of hive-close, strictly after the review.passed / status_override(done) emits and after the existing scoring step. Failure takes the else branch: a stderr block stating the close SUCCEEDED and is durable, that only tasks.md/tasks.csv are stale, and the one recovery command. It is the last statement in the file and the group's exit status is the trailing echo's, so hive-close still exits 0 — a successful close never looks failed.
